name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-copilot-apps-ms-employee-hub
title: Microsoft Employee Hub
shortDescription: Four employee workspaces and 30 intent-specific Copilot components over synthetic workplace, HR, IT and business records.
longDescription: Browse published stories, plan leave, track technology help and compare actual bookings with forecast movements. Focused tasks retain context on expansion.

Try an inline component: A place to meet: "Find a step-free room in London for six." Your learning path: "What learning is due next?" Device passport: "Does my assigned laptop need attention?" Lead conversion: "How many partner leads in Germany became opportunities this quarter?"
The sample developer is Contoso. Five Teams personal apps and a separate Cowork connector accompany the SPFx solution. These local fixture captures are not authenticated host evidence.
